name: Paradise ee
source:
Main character is a member of resort club and is sent to a remote island called paradise ee. There are four angels working here as guides during day time and giving private service during night time.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是度假村俱乐部的成员，被送往一个名为天堂ee的偏远岛屿。有四位天使白天在这里担任向导，晚上则提供私人服务。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
